description: Write the short, polite message asking a manager for the leave days of a break, in the same words as the Leave Hacker app. Pass the dates to book; the break's first and last day are worked out from the weekends (and bank holidays, if you pass region) either side unless you pass them.

dates_to_book.description: The working days to book as leave (yyyy-MM-dd).

region.description: Optional, to count bank holidays next to the dates: england-and-wales, scotland or northern-ireland for UK bank holidays (from gov.uk); IE for Ireland; an Australian state or territory as AU-NSW, AU-VIC, AU-QLD, AU-WA, AU-SA, AU-TAS, AU-ACT or AU-NT (their public holidays differ a lot); US for US federal holidays; or a two-letter ISO 3166-1 country code such as DE or FR for other countries' public holidays (from Nager.Date).

name: leave_request_message
title: Leave request message
